 Order
This first application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C has been filed for grant of bail.
2. The applicant has been arrested on 21.03.2024 in connection with Crime No.22/2024 registered at Police Station - Sailana, District Ratlam for offence under Sections 376, 506 of IPC.
3. In view of the fact that the prosecutrix was minor, no case is made out for grant of bail.
4. Accordingly, the application fails and is hereby dismissed.

(G. S. AHLUWALIA) JUDGE VB*
